JavaScript.","verdict":"SUPPORTED","reasoning":"Passage 0 gives this exact example and explains that sqlite3_limit() allows trusted internal databases to be unconstrained while tightly limiting databases controlled by untrusted external code.","citations":[{"index":0,"quote":"a web browser application might use an internal database to track historical page views but have one or more separate databases that are created and controlled by javascript applications that are downloaded from the internet. If the page size is increased to the maximum of 65536 bytes, then the database file can grow to be as large as about 281 terabytes."}]},{"claim_text":"Most applications are expected to need higher limits rather than lower ones.","verdict":"CONTRADICTED","reasoning":"Passage 7 says increasing a limit is expected to be rare and that more commonly an application might want lower limits.","citations":[{"index":7,"quote":"Some applications may want to increase a limit here or there, but we expect such needs to be rare.
